Yes, this gives me the experience I wanted. I can focus on what remains, mark something finished without losing it, find it again in the Finished view, and restore it to To read if needed. Search and the status views also work together in a way that feels predictable, including the changing counts.

The full prominence in Finished and gentle dimming only in All feel right. I’m happy with this part and ready to look at those boundary situations.
